_role: static action-class arm (no !agent relay): place / use-block / equip end-to-end, judged on WORLD STATE and SLOT CONTENTS (D2/T20)
_expect: place: ok=True with blockBefore=minecraft:air, blockAfter=minecraft:stone_bricks, supportAfter=minecraft:smooth_stone at 2003,121,10, PLUS the in-band post-probe 'execute if block 2003 121 10 minecraft:stone_bricks' => rc=1 in the receipt. use-block: 'use target=block' on the platform top (2003,120,9) reaches tier=place PLUS the post-probe on 2003,121,9 => rc=1. equip: the setup makes armor38=diamond_chestplatex1 and hotbar.1=leather_chestplatex1, so the swap moves the leather into armor38 and the displaced diamond into s1 => state armor 8 -> 3 (NOT 8 -> 8) and BOTH slot contents change. Probe lines print '(rc=1)' on pass and '(rc=0)' on fail; a failed probe means the world-state assertion FAILED (judge by the receipt, never by ok=true alone).
_preconditions: dev save test / scene wall / player gamemode creative / window 1280x800. The ticket rebuilds its own inputs with 'item replace' (hotbar.4 = 16 stone_bricks, armor.chest = diamond_chestplate, hotbar.1 = leather_chestplate) and resets both probe cells with setblock, so it is RE-RUNNABLE and does not depend on leftovers from an earlier round.
_probe_mechanism: stage = external read of a block cell: 'execute if block X Y Z minecraft:air' (pre, replaceability basis) and 'execute if block X Y Z minecraft:<non-air>' (post, independent world-change proof). Vanilla /execute with a condition and no run returns 1 when the condition passes and 0 when it fails; TicketBridge.runServerCmd records that value as '(rc=N)' in the receipt. First in-band use of this mechanism: if rc turns out not to be 1/0 as expected, the probe rows go red and the 判据 must be re-derived -- do NOT count it as a pass.

ops.line: execute run item replace entity @s hotbar.4 with minecraft:stone_bricks 16
execute run item replace entity @s armor.chest with minecraft:diamond_chestplate 1
execute run item replace entity @s hotbar.1 with minecraft:leather_chestplate 1
